purpose: Held-out paraphrases written before the repaired pipeline is run. All profiles are fictional.

profiles.name: [HELDOUT] Taylor
profiles.need: We paste customers' names and account balances into an AI tool when writing updates. I'd like help figuring out what to remove before sharing it.
profiles.offer: I can interview potential customers to understand their current problems, without pitching my solution.

profiles.name: [HELDOUT] Reese
profiles.need: The cards overlap when I shrink my browser to phone width. I need somebody to fix the CSS rules, not just suggest nicer colours.
profiles.offer: I can help minimise sensitive information before using AI, including anonymising examples and removing identifiers. This isn't legal advice.

profiles.name: [HELDOUT] Sky
profiles.need: I have a theory that local shops need my app. I'd like help having useful conversations with shop owners before I start coding.
profiles.offer: I troubleshoot flexbox, grid and media-query bugs that break pages on narrow screens.

profiles.name: [HELDOUT] Darcy
profiles.need: J'ai besoin de traduire une courte description de mon application du français vers l'anglais.
profiles.offer: I can rewrite technical descriptions in everyday language. I don't advise on which product features to build.

profiles.name: [HELDOUT] Remy
profiles.need: My first web project needs a public address. It works when I run it on my own computer and I don't know the next step.
profiles.offer: Je peux traduire de courtes descriptions entre le français et l'anglais.

profiles.name: [HELDOUT] Drew
profiles.need: I need someone to tell me which one of ten proposed features should go into a tiny first release.
profiles.offer: I can help publish web prototypes so other people can use them, including setting up hosting and deployment.

checks.reason: Removing sensitive customer identifiers before AI use versus anonymisation support.
Overlapping phone-width cards versus flexbox/grid/media-query debugging.
Talking to shop owners before building versus customer discovery interviews.
Explicit French-to-English translation request and French-language translation offer.
A local web project needing a public address versus publishing web prototypes.
Rewriting descriptions explicitly does not include choosing features.
Fixing responsive CSS is not writing clearer descriptions.
Deployment does not establish confidential AI data-handling advice.
CSS troubleshooting alone does not offer deployment.
